neighbours.label: Grammar/music/math unit nouns: ' sentence(s)', ' measures', ' equations', ' clause', ' canon' (units of structured text or notation)
fire: Regardless of whether nouns or pronouns are used, the usual sentence order is subject-object-verb in this language.
You keep alternating measures of Em and Emadd9 each time you play the F sharp chord.
She started doing this by balancing chemical equations at the kitchen table every evening.
With the gerund in place, the sentence became grammatical and the teacher nodded in approval.
The relative clause modifies the noun before it, so the whole sentence reads more smoothly.
He rejected the aesthetic canon that defied the ideals of the old art academy.

Try playing the first four measures slowly before speeding up for the chorus.
